goal: Ship an installable host-agnostic task control plane that accepts natural coding requests and proves the authorized delivery boundary through durable state and current evidence.
deliveryBoundary: protected-main release with host UAT and exact asset readback

stories.title: Schemas and lifecycle model
stories.red: Unspecified transitions, terminal resume and gate skips are accepted.
stories.green: Schemas and pure transition functions cover every status, phase and mode rule.
stories.acceptance: CLI fixtures receive stable errors for invalid pause, resume, cancel and close transitions.
stories.recovery: Discard incompatible draft state before first public release.

stories.title: CAS task store and immutable artifacts
stories.red: Two writers with one expected version can both commit or crash leaves canonical state partial.
stories.green: One CAS succeeds and content-addressed artifacts plus canonical pointers are durably atomic.
stories.acceptance: Crash-window fixture recovers the previous record and reports orphaned artifacts.
stories.recovery: Repair reports exact orphan, temp and lock state without deleting a live writer.

stories.title: Candidate identity and evidence freshness
stories.red: Content changes retain full receipts or wrong revisions satisfy environment proof.
stories.green: Deterministic candidate and environment identities drive fail-closed evidence freshness.
stories.acceptance: A real temporary Git repo covers dirty, untracked, commit, amend, scoped-change and package identities.
stories.recovery: Unavailable identity returns a structured missing-proof verdict.

stories.title: Fenced leases and writer ownership
stories.red: A stale sender can mutate after ownership transfer.
stories.green: Lease, scope, fence, version and generations are atomically validated for every mutation.
stories.acceptance: Two Node processes contend for canonical and disjoint story scopes with deterministic winners.
stories.recovery: Reconciliation names the live and expired owners before any new acquisition.

stories.title: Story graph and integration eligibility
stories.red: Cycles, overlapping writes or a second integration writer can proceed.
stories.green: Ready stories, scoped claims, immutable results and single-writer integration are deterministic.
stories.acceptance: Two independent lanes complete while a blocked lane waits, then integrate once.
stories.recovery: Expired claims return unfinished stories to ready without changing submitted results.

stories.title: Scoped grants and external-attempt reconciliation
stories.red: A stale grant or unknown result can execute twice.
stories.green: Exact grants revoke deterministically and unknown outcomes require readback before retry.
stories.acceptance: A lost provider response reconciles to one external write.
stories.recovery: Only the affected external lane blocks while independent work stays ready.

stories.title: Completion eligibility and status projection
stories.red: Intermediate delivery facts, stale evidence, worker leases or execution grants can close a task, or the integration lease blocks its own completion mutation.
stories.green: Every mode and boundary returns exact current, missing and stale proof; completion requires and atomically retires its own integration lease while rejecting workers and grants.
stories.acceptance: Russian status output exposes the durable phase map, lanes, denominator and receipts.
stories.recovery: Malformed evidence is quarantined and rendered as missing.

stories.title: Exact binding, session resolution and fenced handoff
stories.red: A candidate pointer authorizes work or prepared handoff transfers ownership.
stories.green: Only exact binding and accepted fenced handoff can authorize canonical work.
stories.acceptance: Cross-host fixture resumes exact task across different chat and execution workspaces.
stories.recovery: Retry the same handoff ID; reject a conflicting receiver.

stories.title: Checkpoint, compaction and host hook continuity
stories.red: Resume loses story claims, accepts changed hashes or completion ignores pending DoD.
stories.green: Verified checkpoints restore generations, leases, stories, evidence and exact next action.
stories.acceptance: Fresh processes resume after crash, compaction and handoff interruption with identical status.
stories.recovery: Host transport faults stay visible and canonical mutations remain fail-closed.

stories.title: Spec, plan and bounded review orchestration
stories.red: Clarification or review can be silently skipped or repeated beyond the cap.
stories.green: Mode, ambiguity, frozen generations and classified bounded reviews drive the artifact chain.
stories.acceptance: Clear and ambiguous natural prompts produce different correct flows without a skill name.
stories.recovery: Unavailable reviewer remains missing coverage under the selected mode.

stories.title: Real UAT, release and production evidence adapters
stories.red: Tests substitute for UAT or wrong revision/environment satisfies production.
stories.green: UAT, release, deployment and observation receipts bind exact scenario, candidate and environment.
stories.acceptance: Real local CLI flow and synthetic wrong/right deployment contours preserve proof distinctions.
stories.recovery: Known failure returns to readiness; unknown result enters reconciliation.

stories.title: Public CLI, setup rollback and host adapters
stories.red: Fresh host needs manual skill invocation or setup damages existing configuration.
stories.green: Hash-owned setup, natural-task routing, stable CLI and safe rollback work on both host layouts.
stories.acceptance: Clean Codex and Claude homes install, start a natural task, show durable status and roll back cleanly.
stories.recovery: Prepared setup resumes or rolls back; edited files stop deletion.

stories.title: v0.2 state migration and rollback
stories.red: Malformed, provisional, live or concurrently changing v0.2 state imports while legacy authority can still write.
stories.green: Cutover requires a quiescent stable source, moves it to read-only quarantine, tombstones the old root, verifies legacy write denial, then activates v0.4 state.
stories.acceptance: A concurrent legacy writer blocks cutover; after quiescence the old CLI cannot write and the exact v0.4 task resumes.
stories.recovery: Receipt phase resumes partial migration; rollback requires no v0.4 writer, grant, attempt or post-import mutation and never restarts a legacy host.

stories.title: Integrated trains, public-source freeze and one code review
stories.red: A contract or onboarding scenario can pass without its safety or user-visible behavior, or candidate-changing docs, CI or package metadata follow review freeze.
stories.green: All synthetic trains and public-source checks pass before one independent review freezes the entire candidate.
stories.acceptance: Clear, ambiguous, parallel, review-fix, UAT-red, handoff, delivery, reconciliation and clean-reader/install trains pass.
stories.recovery: Fix blockers test-first and rerun affected scenarios plus the full gate; targeted verification updates the repaired-candidate receipt without another full review. Any later source change reopens this story.

stories.title: Mandatory host UAT and protected v0.4 release
stories.red: Any mandatory host receipt is missing or stale, the frozen candidate changes, or release assets do not match protected main.
stories.green: Both claimed hosts prove every mandatory scenario on the frozen candidate and exact main, tag, package and assets read back.
stories.acceptance: Fresh Codex and Claude sessions each prove natural task, compaction continuation, fresh-chat status, pause/resume and terminal cancellation.
stories.recovery: A host defect or source change returns to CP-014 for RED repair and targeted review verification; reconcile unknown publish state and never retag mismatched assets.
